name: Treg
description: Find keyword search volumes, look up companies, or generate images and video. Sign in and choose a Treg team to use its connected tools. You can check a tool's price before a paid call uses team credits.

prompts.text: Find a tool for monthly keyword search volume. What does one lookup cost?
Which tools has my team connected to Treg?
Use Treg to find the latest OpenBot release and link to its release notes.

apps.name: Treg
apps.description: Search the Treg catalog, check prices, and call tools with your team's account.
